notes_list.title: 🗓️ Chaitra (1st Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Mar–Apr | Hindu naya saal yahin se shuru (21/22 March)
🎉 Tyohar: Ram Navami, Mahavir Jayanti, Chaitra Navratri, Chaiti Chhath
📌 Hindu calendar ka PEHLA mahina
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Chaitra → Chitra. Chitra kiska banwate ho? Maa ka → Maa = MArch. Ram aur Mahavir dono ke sirf 'chitra' hi bache hain → dono Chaitra me. 22 March = Chaitra shuru.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Vaishakh (2nd Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Apr–May | Fasal katai ka mahina
🎉 Tyohar: Baisakhi, Akshaya Tritiya, Buddha Purnima
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Vaishakh → Baisakhi (sahara/crutch). Baisakhi wo rakhta hai jo adhura (viklang) ho. Purnima = POORA. Poora aadmi baisakhi nahi rakhta → Buddha Purnima (poora gyaan) bhi Vaishakh me. Baisakhi = Punjab me fasal katai, April.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Jyeshtha (3rd Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 May–Jun | Sabse bade din (garmi)
📌 Jyeshtha = bada
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Jyeshtha = bada (Mahabharat ka 'jyeshtha bhrata' = bada bhai). Garmi me din bade hote hain → May-June.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Ashadh (4th Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Jun–Jul | Baarish/monsoon shuru
🎉 Tyohar: Guru Purnima
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Aashad ka ulta = BAAD → Baadh (flood). June-July me baarish/baadh. Guru Purnima: Purnima = POORA → baadh me poora ilaka doob gaya → Guru Purnima Ashadh me.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Shravan (5th Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Jul–Aug
🎉 Tyohar: Nag Panchami
🇮🇳 15 August (Independence Day) isi mahine me
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Baadh aayi → baarish → VAN ugte hain → Shravan = Van (Shra-VAN). Van (jungle) me Nag rehte hain → Nag Panchami Shravan me.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Bhadrapad / Bhadon (6th Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Aug–Sep
🎉 Tyohar: Gokulashtami (Janmashtami), Goga Navami
📌 Goga Ji (lok devta) ki puja: Bhadrapad Krishna Navami
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Van ug gaye → rehne ki jagah nahi → BHAAGO → Bhadrapad = Bhaagna. Gokulashtami: Gokul Krishna ko 'bhaya' (pasand tha) → BHAdrapad. Goga: 'Go-Go' (bhaago-bhaago) → Goga Navami Bhadrapad Krishna Navami.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Ashwin (7th Month)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Sitambar me exam hote hain, jiske NUMBER zyada wo WIN karta hai → Ash-WIN = Win → September. ⚠️ Note: Video me Dussehra ko Kartik ke saath bola tha, par asli Ashwin Shukla Dashami hai.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Kartik (8th Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Oct–Nov
🎉 Tyohar: Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Guru Parv (Guru Nanak Jayanti – Sikh)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: KARtik = KAR (car). Car kab lete ho? Diwali/Dhanteras par → Oct-Nov. Diwali, Govardhan, Bhai Dooj sab Diwali ke aaspaas = Kartik. Guru Parv bhi Kartik (Purnima). Note: Mukhya Chhath Puja bhi Kartik me; Chaiti Chhath Chaitra me.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Agrahayan / Margashirsha (9th Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Nov–Dec
📌 Exam me bahut kam poocha jaata hai
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Seedha yaad: Agrahayan = Nov-Dec. 'Aage-Han' → Nov ke aage Dec. Koi khaas trick nahi, bas mahina-naam yaad rakho.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Paush (10th Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Dec–Jan
🎄 Christmas (25 Dec) isi mahine me
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: DEcember → 'Dee' → 'Bhains dee, pus jao' (paush = bhains ko pusana/thaan tatolna taaki doodh de). Paush = Dec-Jan.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Magh (11th Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Jan–Feb
🇮🇳 26 January (Republic Day) isi mahine me
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Magh → MAANG. Maang kiski bharte ho? JAAN ki → JANvari. Magh = January-February.

notes_list.title: 🗓️ Phalgun / Phagun (12th & Last Month)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Feb–Mar | Hindu calendar ka ANTIM mahina
🎉 Tyohar: Holi, Mahashivratri
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Phagun → PHAAG. Phaag kab khelte ho? Holi par. Holi sabse pehle (Mahashivratri) aur uske baad Holi = Phalgun. Phalgun = last, Chaitra = first. Phalgun me Holi, Chaitra se naya saal.

notes_list.title: 🎉 Ugadi (Telugu/Kannada New Year)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📍 Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka (south)
📅 Chaitra Shukla Pratipada (Mar–Apr)
📌 PYQ: Hindu calendar ke hisab se kis mahine me?
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick (video): Ugadi = Uga (suraj uga/naya saal ugta hai). Andhra = andha ko sirf ugta suraj dikhta hai. Fasal katai + naya saal = Baisakhi wale time. ⚠️ Note: Video ke exam answer me Vaishakh tha, par asli Ugadi Chaitra me hoti hai. Exam me options dekh ke dono dhyan rakho.

notes_list.title: 🌕 Purnima Confusion: Buddha / Guru / Guru Parv
notes_list.basic_overview:
🌕 Buddha Purnima → Vaishakh
🌕 Guru Purnima → Ashadh
🌕 Guru Parv (Sikh) → Kartik
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Buddha ko poora gyaan tha, unhe 'baisakhi' ki zaroorat nahi → Vaishakh. Guru Purnima: baadh me poora ilaka doob gaya → Ashadh (Aad = baadh). Guru Parv: car lete ho Diwali par → Kartik.

notes_list.title: 🐍 Goga Navami (Goga Ji)
notes_list.basic_overview:
📌 Lok devta Goga Ji ki puja
📅 Bhadrapad Krishna Navami
(Options: Krishna Shukla Dwadashi / Bhadrapad Krishna Navami / Ashwin Shukla Ashtami / Kartik Krishna Chaturthi)
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: GO-GO = 'bhaago bhaago' → Bhadrapad (bhaagna). Baadh aayi, van ug gaye, ab bhaago → Goga Navami Bhadrapad me.

notes_list.title: 📋 Festival → Month Quick Chart
notes_list.basic_overview:
Chaitra: Ram Navami, Mahavir Jayanti, Chaitra Navratri
Vaishakh: Baisakhi, Akshaya Tritiya, Buddha Purnima
Ashadh: Guru Purnima
Shravan: Nag Panchami
Bhadrapad: Janmashtami, Goga Navami
Ashwin: Dussehra, Sharad Navratri
Kartik: Diwali, Govardhan, Bhai Dooj, Guru Parv
Phalgun: Holi, Mahashivratri
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Revision: Mahina order yaad rakho → Chaitra, Vaishakh, Jyeshtha, Ashadh, Shravan, Bhadrapad, Ashwin, Kartik, Agrahayan, Paush, Magh, Phalgun. Tricks: Maa-Chitra / Baisakhi / Bada / Baadh / Van / Bhaago / Win / Car / Aage / Dee-Pus / Maang / Phaag.
